title: Implement vehicle rigid-body and AWD tire model
acceptance: the player car uses a dynamic Rapier chassis rigid body with a legally distributable placeholder GC8-era vehicle representation rather than kinematic translation

four wheel contacts drive spring/damper suspension and tire forces through Rapier scene queries with configurable wheelbase, track, ride height, spring, damper, mass, and inertia parameters; wheel queries exclude the chassis itself and are evaluated only after the current player tile collision state is physics-ready
longitudinal drive/braking and lateral slip forces produce a progressive grip limit and the AWD drivetrain distributes torque through data-driven parameters
simulation uses a fixed physics timestep decoupled from render framerate, initially targeting 120 Hz, and exposes telemetry for wheel contact, suspension travel, speed, steering, and slip behavior

the dynamic car can accelerate, steer, brake, remain numerically stable on the current Manhattan roadbed fixture, and cross active tile seams without falling through or encountering duplicate contact planes; slope/uneven-grade validation is deferred to T010 after elevation geometry exists
verification: PR #6 head bf5ba98da4528c258574ffe625f2bb69638e1ab9 passed the required hosted npm run check in merge context: strict TypeScript, Vite production build, and 19/19 Vitest tests. The tests include real Rapier WASM suspension/acceleration and a dynamic vehicle crossing between adjacent Roadbed-derived tile colliders while maintaining road contact. Roach project health, lint/types/schemas, and Ubuntu coordination/state validation also passed before merge.

evidence.work: Dynamic Rapier chassis, four self-excluding suspension raycasts, spring/damper contact forces, progressive combined tire grip, data-driven AWD torque split, bounded 120 Hz fixed-step simulation, unbranded GC8-era procedural visual, telemetry, physics-ready tile gating, and Roadbed seam traversal merged through PR #6. docs/VEHICLE_MODEL.md records subsystem boundaries and prototype parameter status.
